CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetCurrentTemplatePath

Returns the absolute path of the file in which the function call appears. Inside an included file or a custom tag, that is the included file or the custom tag, not the requested page.

Category

System functions

Syntax

GetCurrentTemplatePath()

Returns

The absolute path of the current template.

Usage

Handy for custom tags and included files that need to find their own support files, wherever the calling page lives: GetDirectoryFromPath(GetCurrentTemplatePath()). For the page named in the URL, use GetBaseTemplatePath.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Called from</TH><TH>GetCurrentTemplatePath()</TH><TH>GetBaseTemplatePath()</TH></TR>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD>getcurrenttemplatepath.cfm (this page)</TD>
<TD>#GetFileFromPath(GetCurrentTemplatePath())#</TD>
<TD>#GetFileFromPath(GetBaseTemplatePath())#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
<CFINCLUDE TEMPLATE="sn_syswhere.cfm">
</TABLE>
<CFOUTPUT><P>This page lives in #GetDirectoryFromPath(GetCurrentTemplatePath())#</CFOUTPUT>
